scenes.setting: On the clock tower: every gas lamp dies as an evil god's gaze erupts from the red-brick building, then profound darkness snuffs it out; divination says Lanevus is stripped of the godhood and fleeing by sewer — Klein free-climbs down the tower to intercept

Inside the wrecked building: a bleeding, kneeling Cesimir listens to Lanevus's gloating confession — the True Creator's 'sapling', the engineered rescue, every murder a signal flare — before the swindler yanks out the holy bone sword, fails to kill anyone, and dives for the sewers
Deep in the sewer maze, Lanevus runs into a card buried in his chest — thrown by a medium-sized man in a worker's uniform wearing a happy clown mask
